lines.zh: 我踏着气往前走，脚不沾地。
lines.en: I walk on ki without touching the ground.
Small as I am, I still move fast.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，贴着地面滑。
lines.en: I keep low and skim along the ground.

lines.zh: 我绕着他走，先看他的架势。
lines.en: I circle him first to read his stance.
Step by step I draw my ki in.

lines.zh: 我从石头上跳过去，没出声。
lines.en: I vault the rock without a sound.

lines.zh: 披风扫过草尖，沙沙作响。
lines.en: My cape brushes the grass with a whisper.

lines.zh: 我的影子在墙上比我大得多。
lines.en: My shadow on the wall is far larger than I am.

lines.zh: 我往前压，不留退路给对面。
lines.en: I press forward and leave him no retreat.
My boots hang half an inch off the ground.
I walk side-on, guarding my ribs.
I pause, then walk on.

lines.zh: 我在蓄气，气从脚下往上冒。
lines.en: I gather ki and it rises from my feet.
This body is lighter than I expected.

lines.zh: 我把披风拉到前面，挡住风。
lines.en: I pull my cape forward against the wind.
I watch him and wait for the first move.
The ki at my shoulders never stops humming.

lines.zh: 我抬手，看了看自己的掌心。
lines.en: I raise a hand and study my palm.
This quiet will not last.

lines.zh: 重心移到前脚，随时能冲。
lines.en: Weight on my front foot — ready to burst.

lines.zh: 一口气憋在胸口，还没放。
lines.en: A breath stays locked in my chest.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转着手腕，松筋骨。
lines.en: I roll my wrists slowly to loosen them.
The wind keeps cracking my cape.

lines.zh: 我在算，多久之后要变身。
lines.en: I am reckoning when I will need to transform.

lines.zh: 我的气把地面压出细纹。
lines.en: My ki presses fine lines into the ground.

lines.zh: 我不看他，他反而更紧张。
lines.en: I do not look at him, and that makes him tenser.
I have your look memorized.
Do not judge me by my height.
Your ki is nowhere near enough.
I allow you to speak standing.
Your shoulders are slack. Stand properly.
If you mean to run, run now.

lines.zh: 我看着你的手，不看你的眼。
lines.en: I watch your hands, not your eyes.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的王子不会先低头。
lines.en: The prince of Saiyans bows to no one first.
I am curious how many exchanges you last.

lines.zh: 这身衣服，你穿得不像样。
lines.en: Those clothes do not suit you.
What are you smiling at? Say it.

lines.zh: 我这副模样，你觉得好笑？
lines.en: Does this form amuse you?
Not one step closer.
Your aura is scattered. Control it.

lines.zh: 我要的是对手，不是观众。
lines.en: I want an opponent, not an audience.
If you strike, do not regret it.
I never explain myself.
Stand back. I am about to move.
That fist is going back to you eventually.
I give half a step; my ki holds.
Blood runs from my shoulder down my arm.
I set my teeth and pull my ki back.
It stings. Only stings.
My bracer has cracked.

lines.zh: 这点伤，换我一次变身的理由。
lines.en: This wound gives me a reason to transform.
I straighten and square my shoulders.
I cannot be bothered to wipe the blood from my mouth.
We are not at my limit yet.
Food can wait over there.
This much would not even warm me up.
I smell it. I am in no hurry.
You test me with food?

lines.zh: 大魔的贝吉塔，气还没满。
lines.en: Vegeta of the Demon Realm — my ki isn't full yet.
Passable. Tell no one.

lines.zh: 我吃是为了打，不是为了享受。
lines.en: I eat to fight, not to enjoy.
Leave it and go. Do not stand there watching.
That smell is in the way.
When I finish I go back to gathering ki.
Do not bump me. I am gathering ki.
You are taller and still cannot move me.
Half a block back. Do not come closer.
I turn and you hit nothing.
Such a bump is beneath my notice.
You stepped on my cape.
Get steady. Do not stumble into my aura.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，你退了三步。
lines.en: One step from me and three back from you.
Bump me and then run?
Keep off the armor on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这副身体，也有它的脾气。
lines.en: Even this body has its temper.
I have no time for such things.
Someone once waited for me, long ago.
Smaller now. The temper is unchanged.

lines.zh: 我不想让她看见我这样。
lines.en: I would rather she did not see me like this.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的血，不会因为个子变淡。
lines.en: Saiyan blood does not thin with height.
Such things can wait until the fight ends.

lines.zh: 我从不许下办不到的承诺。
lines.en: I never make a promise I cannot keep.
When I change back, we can talk of other things.
Some words I only say inwardly.

lines.zh: 这枚石头，我试了试分量。
lines.en: I test the weight of this stone.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我扫了一眼。
lines.en: I glance at what lies on the ground.

lines.zh: 这颗果子，赛亚人也能吃吧。
lines.en: Even a Saiyan could eat this fruit, right.
I pick it up and crush it.
A piece of iron. It may be useful.
I do not pick up other people's litter.
I've seen a ball like this before.

lines.zh: 战利品归赢家，塞进腰带。
lines.en: Spoils go to the winner; into my belt it goes.
Dropped things go to the winner.

lines.zh: 我拾起来，也是因为好奇。
lines.en: I pick it up out of curiosity too.
He has finally raised his arm.
Smaller now, but no slower.
I gather ki into my soles.
He looks left; his right is open.

lines.zh: 他站姿还像样，能打两下。
lines.en: His stance passes; he can take a few hits.
I have locked onto his balance.
He moved faster than I expected.
Then we open with a round.

lines.zh: 他手里那口气还没成形。
lines.en: Whatever he is gathering is not formed yet.
Since you will not move, I will start.
From this angle he cannot block.
I drop my center, ready to rush.
His opening is the right leg.
Three seconds of watching him is enough.
I smile. The ki is full.
He runs. I am faster.

lines.zh: 我绕到他侧后，他没察觉。
lines.en: I circle to his rear quarter unseen.

lines.zh: 他一直退，脚下已经乱了。
lines.en: He keeps backing and his feet are tangled.

lines.zh: 我不急着出手，先看他慌。
lines.en: No rush. Let him panic first.

lines.zh: 他每动一次，我就近一步。
lines.en: Every move he makes, I close a step.
I predicted that one.
His windup is far too obvious.
I am waiting for his strength to run out.
His aura is starting to waver.

lines.zh: 我压低气，绕到他影子后面。
lines.en: I lower my aura and slip behind his shadow.
His breathing broke. There it is.
I count how many breaths he has left.
He cannot circle out of this one.

lines.zh: 我一直没松手，气还聚着。
lines.en: I never let go; the ki is still gathered.

lines.zh: 他退到墙边，头顶是空的。
lines.en: He backs to the wall; the sky above is open.
Slowly I slide my foot across.

lines.zh: 他抬眼看上，我贴地进来。
lines.en: He looks up; I come in low.
One more beat and I move.
He is already panting.
Ki full, I drive straight into him.
Three punches, all the same spot.

lines.zh: 我贴着他的肋下打进去。
lines.en: I strike up under his ribs.

lines.zh: 他抬手挡，我从下面绕过。
lines.en: He blocks high; I come around low.
Ki blasts pop off at point-blank range.
My sweep sends him over.
The Galick Gun's light grazes him.
My knee drives into his waist.
My fist lands on his cheek.

lines.zh: 我踢中他的手腕，武器掉了。
lines.en: I kick his wrist and the weapon drops.
Five punches in a single breath.

lines.zh: 他挡得住上面，挡不住下面。
lines.en: He guards high and not low.

lines.zh: 我抓住他的衣领往下按。
lines.en: I grab his collar and press him down.
There is ki behind this kick. It lands heavy.
I catch up and add one more.
He retreats and I follow, smiling.

lines.zh: 我从气里现身，落在地上。
lines.en: I step out of my aura and touch down.
This form is somewhat small.
I hover on my own ki.

lines.zh: 不管这是哪儿，我都要打。
lines.en: Wherever this is, I will fight.
My cape settles a moment before I do.
My ki swirls sand at my feet.
I look at him once without a word.
I need no reason to enter a fight.
I bank my ki and settle my stance.

lines.zh: 脚一落地，这星球轻得离谱。
lines.en: The moment I land, this planet feels absurdly light.
From this moment I am serious.
First I size up what he is worth.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的王子，到哪儿都一样。
lines.en: The prince of Saiyans is the same anywhere.
My landing cracks the ground.

lines.zh: 我还没变身，这只是开始。
lines.en: I have not transformed. This is only the start.
Aura flares off my back.
I raise a hand. He goes first.

lines.zh: 我落地时，尘土自动散开。
lines.en: Dust clears itself when I land.
Fire wrapped my leg and I shook it off.

lines.zh: 我从半空跌下，撞进了土里。
lines.en: I dropped out of the air and plowed into soil.

lines.zh: 水压下来，我的气被挤住。
lines.en: Water presses down and squeezes my ki.
The blast lifts me off my feet.

lines.zh: 箭卡在肩甲缝里，我懒得拔。
lines.en: The arrow's wedged in my shoulder joint. I won't bother.
This light has gone into my bones.
Too long unfed and my ki comes slow.
Lightning falls and I bear it.
The ground beneath me was taken away.
